name: flutter-secure-dev-playbook
description: Comprehensive, version-accurate Flutter & Dart reference for Claude Code covering the full app lifecycle: development (widgets, state management, navigation, forms, theming, networking, Firebase, testing, build/deploy), a Secure SDLC/DevSecOps layer (OWASP MASVS/ASVS, STRIDE/PASTA, CWE, AAA/CIA, production security ops), a UX/design and accessibility layer (WCAG 2.2), and a business layer (AdMob ads, subscriptions/memberships, ASO and launch marketing). A SKILL.md router plus 35 on-demand reference files.
